name: U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR on purchases and balance transfers for the first 21 billing cycles. After that, the APR is variable (current rate shown as placeholder [$] on page, not readable). Balance transfer fee: 5% of each transfer amount, $5 minimum. Intro rate does not apply to cash advances.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not mentioned on the product page.

credit_required.notes: Page states: 'In general, our credit card products are for customers with a credit score in the good to excellent range.'

base_rate.description: No base earn rate stated. Only category earn: 4% cash back on prepaid air, hotel and car reservations booked directly in the Travel Center.

categories.label: Prepaid air, hotel and car reservations booked directly in the Travel Center

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back redeemed as statement credit, deposit to U.S. Bank checking or savings account, or as a U.S. Bank Rewards Card. Cash Rewards expire if no reward, purchase, or balance activity for 12 consecutive statement cycles.

benefits.title: $20 Annual Statement Credit
benefits.description: Earn a $20 annual statement credit for 11 consecutive months of purchases. Automatic statement credit applied within 2 statement billing cycles following 11 consecutive calendar months of purchases if account is in good standing.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Get up to $600 reimbursed if your cell phone is stolen or damaged when you pay your monthly cellular bill with your card.

benefits.title: $0 Fee U.S. Bank ExtendPay Plan Annually
benefits.description: Option to set up a 3-month $0 ExtendPay Plan offer each calendar year after the new account 0% introductory purchase APR offer has expired.

benefits.title: Free Credit Score Access
benefits.description: Stay aware of your credit score. Enroll in the mobile app and online banking to view your score at any time.
